title: docs(review): independently assess predicate and policy semantics
body:
Optional, non-blocking review. No recruitment is required; no independent assessment has occurred.

## Summary

 the current implementation has self-verification and finite Core evidence, but no independent semantic review.

## Scope

 review the supported predicate operators, half-open boundaries, relative saturation, beneficiary/recovery windows, and the difference between protocol eligibility and policy choices. Compare against pinned Core/CAP-23 sources. Do not add signing or submission to the product.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record reviewed source versions, functions and each rule-to-implementation mapping.
- [ ] Independently check before/at/after examples for every supported operator and handover role.
- [ ] For discrepancies provide synthetic unsigned input, expected/actual intervals and a regression check; report no findings honestly when appropriate.
- [ ] State unreviewed areas and avoid calling the exercise a formal audit.

Dependencies: `docs/SPEC.md`, `docs/CORE-VERIFICATION.md`, current passing CI. Effort: substantial protocol knowledge; scope review before assignment. Usefulness sessions are also optional and unperformed.


## Tech stack

TypeScript / Node.js 22 and 24; official Stellar SDK 17.4.0. Pinned Stellar Core/CAP sources.

No Wave assignment, points or rewards are promised. Use synthetic unsigned data only.

title: test(resources): characterize maximum plans and malformed inputs
body:
Completed in the recorded finite scope; see evidence comments below. These criteria describe the original task.

## Summary

 structural limits exist, but there is no recorded benchmark/corpus for a maximum 100-operation, 10-claimant plan or adversarial recursive envelope input.

## Scope

 create deterministic synthetic fixtures/corpus within and beyond declared limits; measure local time and memory with runtime/host details, including malformed XDR nesting. Preserve the 1 MiB file boundary and fail-closed behavior. Do not claim universal performance bounds from one machine.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Supported maximum-size plans produce located, deterministic reports without skipped operations.
- [x] Oversized/depth-invalid/trailing/noncanonical inputs return controlled errors; measure representative behavior in an isolated subprocess with a timeout.
- [x] If resource limits are bypassed, provide one reproducible finding, a targeted fix and regression coverage.
- [x] Record commands, seeds, observed limits and remaining SDK parser risk.

Dependencies: independent review of intended supported limits in `docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`; no new service/backend. Effort: medium to substantial, depending on findings.


## Tech stack

TypeScript / Node.js 22 and 24; official Stellar SDK 17.4.0. Development-only verification tooling; see linked repository evidence.

No Wave assignment, points or rewards are promised. Use synthetic unsigned data only.

title: test(platforms): verify native source and installed CLI behavior
body:
Completed in the recorded finite scope; see evidence comments below. These criteria describe the original task.

## Summary

 current local/CI evidence is Linux/Ubuntu; documentation explicitly leaves other native platforms unverified.

## Scope

 run the documented source quick start, offline suite, demo and installed-package checks on each target with Node 22/24. Inspect FIFO test skipping and npm executable handling. Fix reproducible portability defects only; do not infer success from CI configuration alone.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Supply actual OS/Node/npm versions and command results for each tested environment.
- [x] Validate installed command and ESM import; preserve exits 0/1/2 and deterministic output.
- [x] Add CI coverage only after reproducing the platform setup and documenting supported exceptions.
- [x] Update compatibility docs with evidence and any failures, leaving untested environments explicit.

Dependencies: registry access for package installation (or a deliberately warmed cache for optional offline mode), and maintainers with access to the target platforms. Effort: medium. No device purchases or paid runner usage authorized by this draft.


## Tech stack

TypeScript / Node.js 22 and 24; official Stellar SDK 17.4.0. Development-only verification tooling; see linked repository evidence.

No Wave assignment, points or rewards are promised. Use synthetic unsigned data only.
